This is a transcription, not a correctness guarantee. The reader can add, omit or misread words. Full pages, multiple lines and other languages are not supported in this mode.

About the word reader & downloads

Words uses the pretrained TrOCR Small handwriting model, separately from our digit and letter CNNs. It was fine-tuned on English handwriting from IAM. We have not measured word accuracy on this website.

First use downloads about 65 MB of model weights from Hugging Face, plus Transformers.js and WebAssembly from jsDelivr. Downloads may be cached by your browser. Images and recognized text stay on your device; no recognition API or account is used. Internet access is required on first use; offline availability is not guaranteed.

This mode shows the prepared handwriting and original transcription. The CNN class scores and activation maps belong to Digits and Letters modes.

A LITTLE TRANSPARENCY

Trained. Tested.
Open to inspection.

Numbers and letters have their own trained models. Letter recognition treats uppercase and lowercase as the same A–Z class. Try one character at a time, and remember: clean handwriting and noisy CAPTCHA images are different challenges.
